status_at_registration.p2a_result: strict Phase-A failure because full 12-parameter NMAE improvement was 0.0477687 below the frozen 0.05 gate
status_at_registration.exploratory_p2b: an unregistered run on P2a train identities showed a 0.0664 mean SawFM-period MAE reduction and is hypothesis-generating only

question: Is the high-power SawFM period loss caused by insufficient power-balanced supervision rather than lack of physical information or insufficient network depth?
primary_hypothesis: With architecture and parameter routing frozen, equal-identity nine-power supervision improves SawFM period estimation at 35-50 dB relative to both the frozen specialist and a constant estimator, without degrading 10-30 dB.

prohibited: opening or evaluating P2a test predictions for selection
generating or reading a P2b test split before development promotion
changing classification, ISRJ, VFT, routing thresholds, or any other parameter output

frozen_variants.E1: non-learned autocorrelation peak estimator using the known 10 MHz sample rate and 20-80 us lag range
frozen_variants.E2: compute-matched 30 dB-only fine-tuning; the 30 dB view is repeated nine times per identity
frozen_variants.E3: identity-paired nine-power supervised fine-tuning with equal identity and equal power weighting
frozen_variants.E4: E3 plus within-identity prediction-variance penalty weight 0.05; primary candidate

training.initialization: corresponding frozen E0 checkpoint; seeds 3041-3043 map to reference checkpoints 2041-2043
training.selection_metric: selection-role equal-power normalized SmoothL1 total loss

metrics.primary: 35-50 dB MAE reduction versus fit-role constant median and Pearson correlation

interpretation_rules.E1_passes_but_E4_fails: physical information is sufficient; prefer an explicit estimator and stop neural-capacity expansion
interpretation_rules.E3_passes_but_E4_fails: power-balanced supervision works but consistency regularization is harmful; retain E3
interpretation_rules.E4_passes: advance only to a new identity seed confirmation; do not read a development test split
interpretation_rules.all_learned_variants_fail_physical_suffi: stop deep-expert expansion and inspect mixture interference or signal isolation
